data.name: Osiris
data.long_meaning: Osiris was the ancient Egyptian god of the underworld and judge of the dead. He was also the god of the Nile and the king of the gods. He was married to his sister and wife, Isis, and was often depicted as a mummified king. His story is one of the most famous in Egyptian mythology, and his legacy has had a significant impact on Western spiritual traditions.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the cycle of death and rebirth, and the power of love and resurrection.

in_hebrew.name: אוסיריס
in_hebrew.meaning: אוסיריס הוא שם שמקורו במצרים ומשמעותו 'הוא קיים'
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אוסיריס הוא שם שמקורו במצרים העתיקה, והוא קשור לאל המצרי של המוות והתחייה. השם אוסיריס הוא תעתיק של השם המצרי 'וסיר', שפירושו 'הוא קיים' או 'הוא נמצא'. השם אוסיריס אינו מופיע ישירות בכתבי הקודש העבריים, אך הוא קשור למושגים של תחייה וישועה, שמהווים נושאים מרכזיים ביהדות ובנצרות.

in_greek.name: Ὀσίρης
in_greek.meaning: Ὀσίρης σημαίνει ὁ ὄν, ὁ ἐκζῶν
in_greek.long_meaning: Ὀσίρης ἐστὶν ὄνομα Αἰγύπτιον, καὶ σημαίνει τὸν θεὸν τῆς ἀναστάσεως καὶ τῆς ζωῆς. Ἐν τῇ Καινῇ Διαθήκη οὐκ ἀναφέρεται εὐθύς, ἀλλὰ αἱ ρίζαι τοῦ ονόματος συνδέονται μετά τῆς πνευματικῆς ἀναγεννήσεως καὶ τῆς νίκης ἐπί τῷ θανάτῳ.

in_latin.name: Osiris
in_latin.meaning: Osiris significat qui existit, qui vivit
in_latin.long_meaning: Osiris est nomen Aegyptium, et refertur ad deum Aegyptiorum mortis et resurrectionis. In Ecclesia primitiva Christiana, nomen Osiris non invenitur directe, sed radix nominis coniungitur cum resurrectione et salvatione, quae sunt argumenta centralia in traditione Christiana.

data.cultural_impact: Osiris has been widely revered and depicted throughout history, appearing in various forms of art, literature, and popular culture. His connection to the Nile and the underworld has made him a symbol of rebirth, renewal, and eternal life, which has influenced the development of many religious and spiritual beliefs in the Western world.
data.spiritual_significance: Osiris represents the idea of divine kingship and the power of the deceased to attain eternal life through the process of mummification and judgment in the afterlife. His story and mythology have inspired many spiritual and philosophical contemplations on the nature of death and the possibility of life after death. Many modern spiritual practices, such as New Age beliefs and some forms of Wicca, draw on the stories and symbolism of ancient Egyptian gods like Osiris. His association with Isis, the goddess of motherhood and magic, also highlights the importance of the divine feminine in spirituality and the role of the divine in providing comfort, protection, and guidance.
